2607.17948.title: Towards Agentic Agent-based Models: Feasibility, Performance, and Statistical Model Checking
2607.17948.paper_summary: Agent-based models (ABMs) rely on simple, explicit and reproducible rules for individual decision making, while complex collective behavior emerges from interactions among agents. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) make it tempting to replace, enrich, or perturb these rules with LLM-based agentic capabilities. However, this raises a methodological question: how does introducing LLM-driven decisions affect the reliability, computational cost, and behavior of ABM simulations? We investigate this for Mesa ABM models, a popular Python library for ABMs, analyzed by statistical model checking. Building on Mesa's integration with the statistical model checker MultiVeStA, we extend the classical Schelling segregation model with a hybrid population: ordinary agents classify neighbors using the standard symbolic rule, while one agent delegates this task to an LLM through tool calls. The LLM-enabled agent receives natural-language descriptions of neighboring agents and invokes tools that increment counters of similar/different neighbors; these counters determine its happiness according to the original Schelling dynamics. This provides a minimal but controlled setting where the semantic, operational, and computational behavior of LLM-based decisions can be studied inside an otherwise standard ABM. We report preliminary experiments with locally served LLMs of different sizes, showing that smaller models may fail simple semantic classification experiments or become operationally unusable during repeated tool-call generation, while larger tested models pass these preliminary checks. We discuss how statistical model checking can estimate classical ABM observables and quantify the impact of introducing agentic LLM components into simulation models.
2607.17948.paper_summary_zh: 代理基礎模型（ABMs）依賴於簡單、明確且可重複的個體決策規則，而複雜的集體行為則源於代理之間的互動。最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展使得用基於LLM的代理能力來替代、豐富或擾動這些規則變得誘人。然而，這引發了一個方法論問題：引入基於LLM的決策如何影響ABM模擬的可靠性、計算成本和行為？我們針對Mesa ABM模型進行了調查，這是一個流行的Python庫，通過統計模型檢查進行分析。基於Mesa與統計模型檢查器MultiVeStA的整合，我們擴展了經典的Schelling隔離模型，使用混合人口：普通代理使用標準符號規則對鄰居進行分類，而一個代理則通過工具調用將這一任務委託給LLM。啟用LLM的代理接收鄰近代理的自然語言描述，並調用工具來增加相似/不同鄰居的計數器；這些計數器根據原始的Schelling動力學來決定其幸福感。這提供了一個最小但可控的環境，在這裡可以研究基於LLM的決策的語義、操作和計算行為，並且這些決策是在一個標準的ABM內部進行的。我們報告了使用不同大小的本地服務LLM的初步實驗，顯示較小的模型可能在簡單的語義分類實驗中失敗，或者在重複的工具調用生成過程中變得無法操作，而較大的測試模型則通過了這些初步檢查。我們討論了統計模型檢查如何估計經典ABM可觀察量，並量化將代理LLM組件引入模擬模型的影響。
